jamie: FYI opened a small docs PR to align streaming + pagination snippets across py/ts/go and introduce a tiny resume-checkpoint helper to avoid restarting from page 1 on transient errors. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/534

ravi: nice. can you paste the minimal Python sync and TS async examples here so i can sanity-check the API shape?

jamie: python sync snippet we added:

jamie: ```python
# python (sync) - preserve last page token across retries
from redwood import RedwoodClient
from redwood.docs_utils import resume_pages_sync

client = RedwoodClient()
checkpoint = None
for page in resume_pages_sync(lambda token: client.stream_pages(page_token=token), checkpoint):
    process(page)
    checkpoint = page.next_token
```

jamie: typescript async example:

jamie: ```ts
// typescript (async) - call factory + checkpoint preserved
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference'
import { resumeWithCheckpoint } from '@redwood/docs-utils'

const client = new Redwood()
let checkpoint: string | null = null
for await (const page of resumeWithCheckpoint(() => client.streamPages({ page_token: checkpoint }))) {
  handlePage(page)
  checkpoint = page.next_token ?? null
}
```

lena: looks good. please ensure the TS helper awaits the factory internally (common slip). also add an explicit sentence in the docs that checkpoint is in-memory by default and link to the Redis persistence example for cross-process resume.

jamie: added persistence note and a tiny go snippet showing single-writer rule to avoid races:

jamie: ```go
// go (concise) - single-writer checkpoint pattern
ctx := context.Background()
client := redwood.NewClient()
checkpoint := ""
for {
  iter, err := client.StreamPages(ctx, &redwood.StreamOptions{PageToken: checkpoint})
  if err != nil {
    if !isTransient(err) { log.Fatalf("stream: %v", err) }
    sleep(backoffWithJitter())
    continue
  }
  for iter.Next() {
    page := iter.Page()
    processPage(page)
    if page.NextToken != "" { checkpoint = page.NextToken }
  }
  if checkpoint == "" { break }
}
```
